title: POV: Why Looking Poor Is So Important — Nobody Tells You This
text:

title: Your Life at Every Salary Level — $20K to $1M (Not What You Think)
text:
💡 Your Life at Every Salary Level. What does life actually look like at every income level? From earning $20,000 a year to making over $2 million, each stage brings different opportunities, pressures, and ways of thinking about money. In this video, we explore how salary shapes your lifestyle, financial choices, relationships, and sense of security—and why making more doesn't always mean feeling wealthier. If you're interested in personal finance, wealth building, money psychology, and financial freedom, this perspective may change the way you think about income forever.
